background: type: solid color: "#F6F6F3" elements: - elementId: title elementType: text bounds: - 56 - 34 - 848 - 40 content: text: 位置会变，页面短码不变 fontFamily: Microsoft YaHei fontSize: 26 lineHeight: 1.3 color: "#1C2321" align: - left - top bold: true role: title - elementId: lead elementType: text bounds: - 56 - 80 - 848 - 26 content: text: 跟 AI 说“改第四页”很危险：这个版本的第四页，未必是上个版本的第四页。 fontFamily: Microsoft YaHei fontSize: 16 lineHeight: 1.4 color: "#56615D" align: - left - top - elementId: before-label elementType: text bounds: - 56 - 132 - 120 - 20 content: text: 移动前 fontFamily: Microsoft YaHei fontSize: 13 lineHeight: 1.3 color: "#7A8480" align: - left - top - elementId: before elementType: image bounds: - 56 - 154 - 400 - 50 src: "media/.huandeng-versions/56ef1c090dfe6c7ef847c12ea2f9ed6ef7a90dfd51efd5d5cc23f4e542356b58.png" sourceName: zh-CN-identity-before-4x.png fit: mode: contain - elementId: after-label elementType: text bounds: - 56 - 220 - 120 - 20 content: text: 移动后 fontFamily: Microsoft YaHei fontSize: 13 lineHeight: 1.3 color: "#7A8480" align: - left - top - elementId: after elementType: image bounds: - 56 - 242 - 400 - 50 src: "media/.huandeng-versions/99a0f26c40f623b347b71bf756622aec243fecbc66a1b031013d57de71448afe.png" sourceName: zh-CN-identity-after-4x.png fit: mode: contain - elementId: body elementType: text bounds: - 56 - 314 - 400 - 160 content: text:

位置：这一页现在排第几，随时会变。

页面短码：四位字母加数字，随机生成、不重复，跟着这一页走。

所以直接说“改 HFDV”，AI 就知道是哪一页。

fontFamily: Microsoft YaHei fontSize: 16 lineHeight: 1.6 color: "#3E4845" align: - left - top - elementId: shot-frame elementType: shape shapeName: rect bounds: - 488 - 132 - 416 - 236 fill: type: solid color: "#FFFFFF" border: width: 1 color: "#CBD3CF" - elementId: shot elementType: image bounds: - 492 - 136 - 408 - 228 src: "media/.huandeng-versions/0f856d8826c729d24034a9b44834bca1de9424bc8a2090c9d12e3da901ec571a.png" sourceName: zh-CN-native-browse-reading-4x.png fit: mode: contain - elementId: shot-cap elementType: text bounds: - 488 - 374 - 416 - 36 content: text: 真实界面：浏览视图里，每页同时显示位置和页面短码，并可直接查看历史版本。 fontFamily: Microsoft YaHei fontSize: 11 lineHeight: 1.45 color: "#7A8480" align: - left - top - elementId: ft-mark elementType: image bounds: - 56 - 505 - 16 - 16 src: "media/.huandeng-versions/6b49274a35445235b8ab17f805b83cf3c7f8924630a5ce5ef8455e59aba5faef.png" sourceName: huandeng.png fit: mode: contain - elementId: ft-label elementType: text bounds: - 78 - 505 - 420 - 16 content: text: HUANDENG / 以“页”为单位 fontFamily: Microsoft YaHei fontSize: 11 lineHeight: 1.3 color: "#7A8480" align: - left - middle - elementId: ft-pos elementType: text bounds: - 824 - 505 - 80 - 16 content: text: "0" fontFamily: Microsoft YaHei fontSize: 11 lineHeight: 1.3 color: "#7A8480" align: - right - middle field: main-position notes: 和 AI 交流的时候，你说第一页、第二页、第三页，但如果你改过顺序，第一页第二页第三页就已经不是那个地方了。所以我们把两个东西分开：位置，是它现在在第几页，会变；页面短码，是专属于这一页的 ID，四位字母加数字的编码，随机生成、不重复。左边是同一页 HFDV 移动前后的状态栏：位置从 2 变成了 4，短码没变。你跟 AI 说 HFDV，它就知道具体是哪一页。有了这个 ID，才能对每一页做版本管理。

designIntent.purpose: 位置会变、页面短码不变，用 HFDV 前后对比说明。
